alun-alun-square.x: Alun-Alun Square is an outdoor area east of the [[lake|lake]]. It is closed off at all times except for specific [[festival|festivals]] that take place in the square.

The [[cherry-blossom-potluck|Cherry Blossom Potluck]] is held on [[spring|Spring]] 10. You can access the square between 9:00 - 14:00 by interacting with the festival orb at the entrance (located at the South-West corner of the [[lake|lake]]).

The [[harvest-festival|Harvest Festival]] is held on [[fall|Fall]] 15. You can access the square between 19:00-22:00 by interacting with the festival orb at the entrance (located at the South-West corner of the [[lake|lake]]).
Alun alun (Indonesian) means square, that makes Alun-Alun square means square square. Similar to the use, or rather, misuse of chai tea (chai means tea) or naan bread (naan means bread).

tidal-threads.x: Tidal Threads is a clothing store in [[merfolk-kingdom|Merfolk Kingdom]] owned by [[lanin|Lanin]].

cho-oyus-tail-shop.x: Cho Oyu's Tail Shop is a shop selling tails at Merfolk Kingdom. Currently only 1 tail can be owned and equipped at all times.

oracle-chamber.x: The Oracle Chamber is located in [[merfolk-kingdom|Merfolk Kingdom]] and is currently run by the Oracle of the Kingdom, [[cho-oyu|Cho Oyu]].
The player can come to Cho Oyu with underwater products to upgrade their seeds or seaweed. The player can also purchase various items from the register or upgrade equipment that they have.
For the tail customization catalog, see [[cho-oyus-tail-shop|Cho Oyu's Tail Shop]].

The shop allows the player to purchase seed or seaweed upgrades for underwater produce and animal products. The research takes time, and only one upgrade can be bought at a time. After the upgrade is completed, the player is not required to collect it manually from the lab, furthermore, the result will automatically be applied to all existing and future seed/seedling/sapling and seaweed (whether they are in inventory, chest or already planted or future purchase from shops).

These act as a one time purchase, and upon purchase, the player will obtain the item and the crafting recipe. Going forward, crafting the items manually will require fewer ingredients. The different types of upgrades need to be purchased in order, there is no possibility to go straight for the more advanced ones.

giant-village.x: Giant Village is an area west to player's [[farm|farm]]. Initially it is partially unlocked by progressing through « Mythical Dream », and became fully accessible after completing « Giant Village ». The village is where the [[giant|Giant]]s live, and where the player can [[enchanting|enchant]] the [[tool|tool]]s.

bamboo-forest.x: Bamboo forest, or also known as bamboo sanctuary, is unlocked the following day after completing any ten offerings at the Lake Temple. The area is rich with [[bamboo-shoot|Bamboo shoot]] and is where [[pandazen|Pandazen]] lives.

diving-pier.x: The Diving Pier is located in the Beach, southeast of the [[coral-inn|Coral Inn]]. The boat at the pier can be used by the player for [[diving|Diving]], once diving is unlocked. While the pier is open at all hours, the player can only start a dive between 6:00 and 23:00.

guardian-mural.x: The Guardian Mural is an altar located between the [[lake-temple|Lake Temple]] and [[anne|Anne]]'s house.

The Guardian Mural consists of the guardian altar that is unlocked after reaching [[town-rank|town rank A]]. After a cutscene with the Goddess at the Lake overlook area, she will direct the player to restore a mural in the grassy lake area by completing altar requests using the ability Divine Blessing, which allows players to speak with the guardians.

The player will be assigned the quest « Guardian Mural ». There are four guardians with corresponding offerings that will each unlock a portion of the mural once complete. Additional [[waypoint|waypoints]] will unlock, connecting each discovered Guardian to the player's farm using red flowers.

underwater-ranch.x: The Underwater Ranch is located on the west side of [[merfolk-kingdom|Merfolk Kingdom]] and it is run by [[slamet|Slamet]]. The shop is available once the player receives the [[merfolk-blessing|Merfolk Blessing]].
The player can purchase a variety of underwater livestock here once they have the [[underwater-barn|underwater barn]] to keep them, as well as feed and tools for their care.

savannah.x: Savannah is a unique and mysterious biome north of [[starlet-town|Starlet Town]]. It is known for its distinctive animals and peculiar mushroom plants . Players can enter through a giant rafflesia flower, which teleports them into the Savannah. Unlike the rest of Coral Island, the Savannah’s weather stays sunny all the time.

Savannah is unlocked after completing 18 [[lake-temple|altars]] and the « Petrified Giant IV ? » quest. The player must also break the giant boulder next to [[paul|Paul]]'s house (need a bronze pickaxe minimum). After completing 18 altars, a cutscene will play where the [[goddess-of-flowers|Goddess of Flowers]] will open a bridge to the savannah. [[waypoint|Waypoint]]s to the savannah are unlocked from completing said offerings and triggering a cutscene with [[lady-lavanna|Lady Lavanna]] as part of the « Guardian Mural ».

[[cave-of-memories|Cave of Memories]] is an endless cavern like cave that is located in the northwestern part of the savannah. In the cave, the player will be tasked to collect [[gort|Gort]]'s memory fragments for the quest « The Final Giant ». The player can also find geodes and coffers, amongst many other things, as they descend the cave of memories.

[[treasure-bubbles|Treasure Bubbles]] are gachapon-like trees that offers players the chance to obtain some exclusive items in exchange for crops. Players can submit $1000 worth of any crop, regardless of quality, and in return, they will receive one tumbleweed capsule. Each player can pull up to five times a day from a single tree. Special rewards from the troves are exclusive decor items that can only be obtained using the treasure tree.

There are two treasure bubbles in the Savannah, each offering different types of decor. · West Side Treasure Bubbles: Located on the west side of the Savannah, this trove provides indoor decor items. · East Side Treasure Bubbles: Found on the east side of the Savannah, this trove offers outdoor decor items.

[[savannah-ranch|Savannah ranch]] is the residence and shop of [[lady-lavanna|Lady Lavanna]] located in the southwestern part of the savannah. The player can purchase [[buffalo|Buffalo]]es, [[ostrich|Ostrich]]es, and [[furniture|furniture]] in the ranch, as well as challenging the shop owner to a race.

Fenn's secret maps can be acquired from [[treasure-bubbles|Treasure Bubbles]] or chests inside the [[cave-of-memories|Cave of Memories]]. It offers the players a chance to hunt for treasure by following the route drawn on the map and using a hoe to dig where the treasure is indicated. The player can retrieve one treasure per day for each map.

The Savannah offers a unique biome where the weather is always sunny and in turn invites different types of flora and fauna year round. Mushroom trees are scattered throughout the area and drop [[hardwood|hardwood]], [[slime-goop|slime goop]] or [[mushroom-group|mushrooms]] when chopped down. Grass is also abundant in the area for collecting [[hay|hay]] and [[fiber|fiber]].

cave-of-memories.x: The Cave of Memories is located at the northwestern corner of the [[savannah|Savannah]] map. Initially inaccessible, the cave becomes available after completing all the offerings at the [[lake-temple|Lake Temple's]] advanced altar.

Inside the cave, the player can gather resources; such as [[ore-group|ore]]s, [[fossil|fossil nodes]], and [[coffer|coffer]]s. However, there are aggressive [[monster|monsters]] roaming around, and sometimes the player will need to defeat them first before going to deeper into the cave.
The Cave of Memories is also the source of getting [[dino-print-group|dino prints]] in order to complete the museum hologram quest.
Daily loot

Before entering the shaft, the player can view a list of the day's available loot. Every day, the list is randomized to include 3 items, 2 giant crops, and 1 mushroom tree to spawn on all floors of the cave.
Giant crops
An axe or explosives can be used to break down giant crops:
Floors

When descending the cave, the player will encounter checkpoints every 25 floors, starting from floor 25 until floor 125. The checkpoints serve as a starting point for the player to continue going further down the cave. Each time the player unlocks a checkpoint, a cutscene will trigger after which the player can retrieve [[gort|Gort]]'s [[quest|memory fragment]].
In addition, each floor has the possibility of having ore veins and fallen logs.
Floors 1-25

Floors 1-25 have a yellow mushroom theme and contain rocks similar to those found in the [[cavern|earth mine]]. In addition to [[monster|monsters]] found in the cavern, the first 25 floors introduces earth or rock type variants that are harder to defeat.
Yellow gem nodes in this section contain the following:
The checkpoint on floor 25 contains a chest with [[wellness-fruit|Wellness fruit]].
Floors 26-50

Floors 26-50 have a purple mushroom theme and contain rocks similar to those found in the [[cavern|water mine]] and the section before. In addition to [[monster|monsters]] found in the cavern and the section before, the floors introduces water or ice type variants that are harder to defeat.
Blue gem nodes in this section contain the following:
The checkpoint on floor 50 contains a chest with [[wellness-fruit|Wellness fruit]].
Floors 51-75

Floors 51-76 have a red mushroom theme and contain rocks similar to those found in the [[cavern|fire mine]] and the sections before. In addition to [[monster|monsters]] found in the cavern and the sections before, the floors introduces fire type variants that are harder to defeat.
Red gem nodes in this section contain the following:
The checkpoint on floor 75 contains a chest with [[wellness-fruit|Wellness fruit]].
Floors 76-100
Floors 76-100 will have random themes chosen from the previous 3 themes. Yellow, blue, and red gem nodes are also randomly generated and not dependent on the floor theme.
The checkpoint on floor 100 contains a chest with [[wellness-fruit|Wellness fruit]].
Floors 125 and beyond
Floors 125 and beyond will have random themes like floors 75-125. Yellow, blue, and red gem nodes are also randomly generated and not dependent on the floor theme.
No more checkpoints are available and the player can only go as deep as floor 125 when they reenter the cave. However, there is no limit to how deep the player can descend.
Special floors
Special floors are randomly generated as the player descends the cave. These floors can be unique in resources or offer a challenge to the player.
Mushroom floors

Mushroom floors contain mushroom rocks instead of rocks that the player can break down with an [[axe|Axe]]. Mushroom rocks commonly drop [[wood|wood]] and [[fiber|fiber]]. In addition, mushroom trees are much more common on this floor.
Monster floors

Monster floors are filled with [[monster|monsters]] that must all be defeated if the player wants to advance to the next floor. If the player's health is depleted, the player will be kicked out of the cave.
Treasure floors
Treasure floors are filled with [[foraging|scavengeables]] and gem nodes. A treasure chest in the center of the room can possibly contain a [[fenns-secret-map|Fenn's secret map]].
Scavengeables
The following [[foraging|scavengeables]] can also be found throughout all floors of the cave:

merfolk-general-store.x: Merfolk General Store is a location in [[merfolk-kingdom|Merfolk Kingdom]]. It is also [[todi|Todi]] and [[lawu|Lawu]]'s house.
The player can sell various crops directly instead of using [[shipping-bin|shipping bin]] and will still trigger the corresponding [[badges|badges]] earning.
Todi sells ocean seeds. Seeds are unlocked by selling 50 of each type of crop.

savannah-ranch.x: The Savannah ranch is located in the southeastern area of the [[savannah|Savannah]] and it is run by [[lady-lavanna|Lady Lavanna]].

The player can purchase a variety of livestock here once they have the necessary farm buildings to keep them, as well as indoor and outdoor decor. The [[furniture|furniture]] items are also available as a random reward at the [[treasure-bubbles|treasure bubble trees]].
Lady Lavanna opens savannah ranch as soon as the player meets them for « Guardian Mural ».

r: Adult ostrich. Lives in the coop. Will lay ostrich eggs when properly cared for.
Adult buffalo. Lives in the barn. Will produce buffalo milk when properly cared for.

savannah-ranch.x: Players can challenge Lady Lavanna to a race, and if they win, they will receive a discount on her furniture items. To qualify for a race, the player needs to build a [[stable|stable]] and acquire a [[horse|horse]]. The player does not need to bring their horse to the race. Achieving a race time below 24 seconds for the first time will earn players a special reward: one [[wellness-fruit|Wellness fruit]].

deep-forest.x: Deep Forest is an area in the northwestern side of the [[forest|Forest]].
Deep forest is unlocked the next day after completing 14 offerings at any [[lake-temple|altar]] at the lake temple.

[[king-tan|King Tan]] lives on the northwest side of the deep forest. The player will be able to speak to him after receiving the quest « Guardian Mural ». After speaking to King Tan, the [[waypoint|waypoint]] to deep forest is unlocked.

The Dig site is located by the entrance to the deep forest. The area offers rocks and tillable soil for the player to collect resources, such as [[fossil|fossil nodes]] and rocks . The dig site refreshes every week.

Deep forest offers some unique opportunities for the player to catch wildlife and gather resources. [[poplar-tree|Poplar]] and [[mahogany-tree|mahogany]] trees are only found in the area and make a great source of [[hardwood|Hardwood]] that renews every season. Grass is also abundant in the area for collecting hay and fiber.
The following [[fish|fish]] can be caught at the deep forest under specified conditions. Available fish are not shown on the [[sturdy-computer|Sturdy computer]].

mrs-ramen.x: Mrs. Ramen is a ramen shop run by [[emma|Emma]] above [[socket-and-pan|Socket and Pan]] in the town center. The shop offers [[cooking|cooked]] meals for sale.
Mrs. Ramen is unlocked by building the [[attractions|attraction]] after achieving [[town-rank|Town rank]] A.
The items sold in the ramen shop are available all year round. These items are not available [[sturdy-computer|online]].

recreation-center.x: Recreation center is located on the old [[pufferfish-drilling-corp|Pufferfish Drilling Corp]] lot, across from the [[starlet-town|town]] cemetery.

Recreation center is unlocked by building the [[attractions|attraction]] after achieving [[town-rank|Town rank]] A. The player can add more services by building the coral cinema, mini golf, and arcade center.
Eva's bakery shop sells [[cooking|cooked]] and [[artisan-product|artisinal]] desserts for sale.
The items sold in the bakery are available all year round. These items are not available [[sturdy-computer|online]].

purwo-woods.x: Purwo Woods is a location that is only accessible through the [[tree-planting-festival|Tree Planting Festival]].

Once you start the festival, the [[townies|townies]] and the [[player|Player]] walk into the Caverns and travel by boat to [[purwo-woods|Purwo Woods]]. Outside of the festival, Purwo woods is unreachable.
Initially, Purwo Woods is barren and only contains stumps in the dirt. Over 3 years of attending the festival, the player and the townies restore the area to a lush forest.
Completing the tree planting activity will earn 150 or as part of the side quest completion, and can only be done up to three times.

mid-forest.x: Mid Forest is an area in the southern side of the [[forest|Forest]].
Mid forest is unlocked the next day after completing 6 offerings at any [[lake-temple|altar]] at the lake temple.

Mid forest offers some early game opportunities for the player to catch wildlife and gather resources. Fallen logs are found in the area and make a great source of [[hardwood|Hardwood]] early game that renews every day. Grass is also abundant in the area for collecting hay and fiber.

treasure-bubbles.x: Treasure Bubbles are gachapon trees that offers players the chance to obtain exclusive items in exchange for crops. There are two in the [[savannah|Savannah]] to the east and the west.

Players can submit 1000 or worth of any crop, including undersea crops, regardless of quality, and in return, they will receive one tumbleweed capsule. Each player can pull up to five times a day from a single tree. Special rewards from the troves are exclusive decor items that can only be obtained using the treasure trove. Special rewards are wrapped inside golden tumbleweed capsules.
The tree to the west of [[savannah-ranch|Savannah Ranch]] offers [[furniture|indoor decor items]] in addition to treasure maps.
The tree on the east side of the [[savannah|Savannah]] offers [[furniture|outdoor decor items]] in addition to treasure maps.

recycling-center.x: Recycling Center is a gachapon trove that offers players the chance to obtain exclusive items in exchange for [[trash|trash]]. At the beginning of the game, the Recycling center serve as a small place where player can scythe for trash. After version 1.1 release, the player can unlock the [[attractions|attraction]] Junior Upcycler to have a fully functional recycling center.
Players can submit 500 [[trash|trash]] to receive one trash bag capsule. The player can pull up to ten capsules a day.

Special rewards from the recycling center are exclusive shed skins wrapped inside a golden trash bag capsule. Tier A and B rewards the player with [[pufferfish-drilling-corp|Pufferfish]] [[furniture|indoor and outdoor decor]] items. These items can only be obtained at the recycling center and from the [[pufferfish-shop|Pufferfish online store]], via [[sturdy-computer|Sturdy computer]].
Special rewards from the recycling center are exclusive shed skins wrapped inside a golden [[trash|trash]] bag capsule.

pufferfish-shop.x: Pufferfish Shop is a store accessible through the [[sturdy-computer|Sturdy computer]].
These items are also available at a booth during [[beach-cleanup-day|Beach Cleanup Day]].

underwater-farm.x: The underwater farm is where [[player|player]]s can live, grow [[ocean-crops|ocean crops]], and tend . The underwater farm is located southeast of [[merfolk-kingdom|Merfolk Kingdom]].

After achieving [[town-rank|Ocean rank]] A and completing the ceremony, the player receives mail from [[krakatoa|King Krakatoa]], inviting the player to help rebuild the [[merfolk-kingdom|Merfolk Kingdom]]. After visiting, the player will receive the quest « Resupply Merfolk Kingdom » and unlock the [[underwater-farm|underwater farm]].
Like the [[farm|land farm]], the underwater farm begins overgrown, but with the help of [[tool|tool]]s, it can be turned into valuable underwater farmland.

The underwater farmhouse is the player's alternate residence and the area where they start every game day if they choose to sleep there. The underwater farmhouse has the player's bed. The player can customize how their underwater farmhouse looks and place [[furniture|furniture]] inside that can be placed in water.

In the beginning, the player's underwater farm has their underwater farmhouse, the [[shipping-bin|shipping bin]], a [[carnivorous-plant|Carnivorous Plant]], and [[mail|mailbox]] (which connects to the land one as well).
Currently, the player can only build an [[underwater-barn|underwater barn]] through the [[underwater-ranch|Underwater Ranch]] and place them at the underwater farm to grow .

Debris are items like trash and seaweeds that the player can clear with their [[tool|tools]]. When first receiving the farm, it is overgrown with debris, and the player must clear it to free space for their crops, machines, and buildings. Debris will also spawn on unoccupied land over time.

sales-cart-stall.x: Sales Cart Stall is a shop in [[merfolk-kingdom|Merfolk Kingdom]] run by [[vihren|Vihren]].
This list is for the furniture that can be used to decorate the inside of the farmhouse.
This list is for the furniture that can be placed around the farm.

empty-cabin.x: The Empty Cabin is located next to the [[cavern|cavern]]. It is a secret shop ran by [[concerned-monkey|Concerned Monkey]]. Once any requirement below is cleared, the player will receive a letter and then the store would be available.

The cabin offers an assortment of [[clothing|clothing]], [[scarecrow|scarecrow]]s, and [[furniture|furniture]] for the player to purchase. The items in stock are unlocked by completing in-game achievements such as collecting most of the [[badges|badges]], getting DLC, and some other hidden requirements.

furniture-store.x: Furniture Store is a shop in [[starlet-town|Starlet Town]] run by relatives of [[joko|Joko]] the local carpenter. The player can find various styles of furniture in here and more stuff becomes available as they upgrade the [[town-rank|town rank]].
Periodically, seven items will be available to purchase from the floor for 10% off.
These items are also available [[sturdy-computer|online]] and not restricted by the shop operating hours.
This list is for the furniture that can be used to decorate the inside of the farmhouse.
This list is for the furniture that can be placed around the farm, outside of the farmhouse

ratihs-float-market.x: Ratih's Float Market is a shop owned and operated by visiting merchant [[ratih|Ratih]]. The shop is located right in front of the [[rajas-coffee-corner|Raja's Coffee Corner]] on docks on Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday mornings. The shop sells various artisan products and seeds. It does not appear during Winter.

The Float Market stock refreshes weekly before the store opens on Tuesday, and will be sold out for the week once purchased. The items sold have a 75% of 1 being available and a 30% chance of 5 being available, with no change to the price.
The artisan products sold offer one item of each type, with 3 or 4 types at once.
Every day Ratih has one type of produce for sale depending on the current season.

Every day Ratih has one type of seeds (or one type of seeds and one seedling) for sale. The seeds available are determined by the player's [[town-rank|Town rank]] and the current [[calendar|season]]. The seed prices are the same as they are at [[sams-general-store|Sam's General Store]]. Note that the town ranks required for certain seeds at Float Market do not match the town ranks required for the same seeds at the general store.

black-market.x: Black Market is a secret store run by [[ratih|Ratih]] on Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday nights on a boat by the [[lighthouse|lighthouse]]. Black Market offers a random selection of rare items.

The Black Market is available at the start of the game and can be freely visited and shopped in with no additional requrements; however, if the player does not find and visit the market by themselves they will eventually get the invitation from [[ratih|Ratih]]:

Despite the days Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday being listed in the invitation, the Black Market is actually available on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Fridays - the same days as [[ratihs-float-market|Ratih's Float Market]]. The content of the invitation has not been updated to reflect the days being changed in v0.4.

The Black Market stock refreshes weekly on the Sunday before the store opens, and will be sold out for the week once purchased. The items are sold at a high price, making it unrecommended to buy them here if they're sold elsewhere (e.g., [[kelp|Kelp]]s at the [[laboratory|Laboratory]]).

Only one item of each type will be available each week, with the exception of [[scrap|scrap]], which has a 75% of 1 being available and a 30% chance of 5 being available, with no change to the price. Once the stamina fruit is bought, it will not be available again.

clinic.x: Clinic is the place where the player can purchase medicine or potions. [[yuri|Yuri]] and [[charles|Charles]] work here and can be seen inside the clinic on certain days.

There is an area where the player can purchase items, a waiting room with medical posters, and exam rooms. There is a small inventory area where they keep extra vitamins and this is where Yuri usually works.

community-center.x: The Community Center is a building in the center of Starlet Town that contains 5 key areas located around an open foyer. with open floor plan where town activities are usually held. “Meetings” by [[theo|Theo]] and [[jack|Jack]] are done in the community center.
To the right of the main entrance, outside of the Community Center, there is a banner which displays the next upcoming [[festival|festival]].
The Yoga/Wellness Room is located left of the entrance of the Community Center. It hosts an open space for meditation and yoga classes, which are led by [[leah|Leah]].

The [[pet-shelter|Pet Shelter]] is located right of the entrance of the Community Center. The shelter is looked after by [[mark|Mark]], and home to the [[pet|pets]] available for adoption. The pet shelter has various pets for adoption. Currently 3 Pets can be adopted and cannot be changed/returned. Adoption costs 2,250  and requires pet house/bed, purchased at the store mat.
This section extends to an outdoor, fenced in, area for the animals to access. You can access this space by heading the the door on the bottom right corner of the room.
Judge Ross's Chamber is located in the far left corner of the Community Center. This is the office of [[judge-ross|Judge Ross]].
There, you can interact with her desk, where it opens a page for you to change your name, honorific and farm's name for free.
The [[library|Library]] is located in the far right corner of the Community Center. [[millie|Millie]] works here. Reading books from the library increases skill levels.

The Town Hall is located at the very back of the Community Center. This is a meeting space for the townies when [[connor|Connor]] hosts a town meeting. The player can use the screen on the back wall to see their [[town-rank|town rank]] and interact with the desk in front to access the [[merit-points|Merit Points]] shop.
After achieving Town Rank A, the Town Hall will allow players to build [[attractions|Attractions]] to improve the island to Town Rank S.

fishensips.x: Fishensips, or also known as Tavern, is an old Irish pub in [[starlet-town|Starlet Town]] docks owned by [[betty|Betty]] and run by her sons, [[noah|Noah]] and [[frank|Frank]]. Betty and Noah live in the upstairs portion of the pub, while Frank lives with his wife, [[erika|Erika]], on [[2-parkview|Parkview]]. The tavern was run by Betty's late husband, Frank Sr., prior to his passing.

The tavern opens every day, with the exception of Wednesday, from noon to almost midnight. It has a casual ambience that also has a country loud vibe. The player can purchase food and beverages from the register.

Most items in stock are sold all year round; however, the selection slightly changes in [[winter|Winter]]. These items are also available [[sturdy-computer|online]] and not restricted by the shop operating hours.

sams-general-store.x: Sam's General Store is a location in [[starlet-town|Starlet Town]]. It is also [[sam|Sam]] and [[emily|Emily]]'s house.

The player can purchase various items such as cooking supplies, tortillas, bread, cookies, seeds, and farming supplies. The store has a cash register, fresh produce section, and bakery section where [[eva|Eva]] works at.
The player can sell various crops directly instead of using [[shipping-bin|shipping bin]] and will still trigger the corresponding [[badges|badges]] earning.

Sam sells several [[consumables|consumable]] items and [[cooking|cooking]] ingredients and seasonal seeds. More items are unlocked as the player reaches higher [[town-rank|town rank]] and time passes. Items from general stock and seeds are also available [[sturdy-computer|online]] and not restricted by the shop operating hours.

socket-and-pan.x: Socket & Pan is a shop located between the [[laboratory|Laboratory]] and the [[furniture-store|Furniture Store]]. [[luke|Luke]] owns and operates the store. The player can buy utensils required for [[cooking|cooking]] here once the house has been upgraded to include a kitchen.
The items are one time purchase only.

Every Tuesday, Socket Electronics appears on the Coral Shopping channel on the television to announce a sale on a randomly selected utensil. The chosen item will be 10% off through the rest of the week.

hair-salon.x: Hair Salon sits next to the [[clinic|Clinic]] and eventually shares a building with [[white-flamingo|White Flamingo]]. It is run by both [[emily|Emily]] and [[erika|Erika]]. The shop is open Tuesday-Friday 9am-5pm, Sunday 12pm-5pm, and closes on Mondays and Saturdays.
The Salon allows the player to redesign their character's physical features - hairstyle, face, facial hair, and body - for 500 .

victorian-mansion.x: Victorian Mansion is a landmark which is the home to [[ling|Ling]], [[leah|Leah]], and [[randy|Randy]]. It is a 100-year-old building, and one of the three original buildings in Coral Island.
The mansion is an old Victorian house, a bit larger in size than other houses in town, but very old. Locals refer to the old house as “mansion” because it was once the epitome of luxury living.

lighthouse.x: An empty lighthouse with spiral stairs to access the top.

abandoned-villa.x: The Abandoned Villa is a villa owned by former residents of Coral Island. Nobody really knows why the family left, but they left abruptly many years ago. Their [[nina|only daughter]], now in her 20s, still visits the villa in the [[summer|summer]]. She is a good friend with [[lily|Lily]] as well as the twins who run the [[coral-inn|Coral Inn]].

beach-shack.x: Beach Shack is a two-story small building made with plain carpentry, painted wild and colorful. It is open for shopping every day except Tuesday and run by local fishermen [[jim|Jim]] and [[sunny|Sunny]]. Sunny also lives on the second floor with his family: wife [[eleanor|Eleanor]] and son [[oliver|Oliver]].

The store sells [[tool|tools]] for [[catching|catching]] and [[fishing|fishing]] and several [[consumables|consumables]]. Some items in stock are only available during certain seasons, while others may be added based on the player's [[masteries|masteries]] level. These items are also available [[sturdy-computer|online]] and not restricted by the shop operating hours.

coral-inn.x: Coral Inn is an inn situated on the pier at the beach.

On the weekend, the Inn can be lively. There are native islanders that visit and relax in the lobby. They are often spotted just reading their weekends away, slouching on a big comfy chair next to an open window, listening to the sound of waves.

hillside.x: Hillside is a small region between the [[forest|Forest]] on the west and the [[woodlands|Woodlands]] on the east. It encompasses [[hillside-brewery-and-vineyard|Hillside Brewery and Vineyard]] as well as the [[observatory|Observatory]] on the hill behind it.

forest.x: The Forest makes up much of the western edge of the [[map|map]], stretching north from the [[farm|Farm]] to the [[cavern|Cavern]], and to the [[hillside|Hillside]] and [[woodlands|Woodlands]] in the east. The [[ranch|Ranch]], [[caravan|Caravan]] and [[huntress-cabin|Huntress Cabin]] can all be found here, as well as a thriving monkey population.

zarahs-boat.x: [[zarah|Zarah]]’s Boat is docked on the pier in the town center. She lives alone and usually cooks or sits around relaxing when she is at home. When she is socializing, she can be found on the pier in front of her boat or with passersby in the forest.

caravan.x: The Caravan is [[ben|Ben]]'s house and the store he runs where he sells random items and occasionally rare findings. The store is open for business every Saturday and Sunday and works differently from most stores: instead of offering the same items for sale for fixed prices, Ben's stock and prices change every weekend.

The prices at the caravan are often lower than they are in other stores; additionally, Ben will randomly give the player a discount or a markup on the base price of all items in his store. That discount or markup is selected randomly every week and applied to all items in stock. The chance to get each particular discount or markup is based on the player's [[friendship|friendship]] level with Ben.
Every week Ben offers a random selection of the items from the following groups:

i: Three different indoor decorations: [[furniture|furniture]] items or flooring
Three exterior decorations: one floor tile or path, one gate, and one fence

caravan.x: The caravan's stock refreshes every weekend. Ben has either one or five instances of each item in stock; for items that have a chance to be stocked in both of those quantities, the chances are as follows: 70% for one and 30% for five items.

huntress-cabin.x: Huntress Cabin is a cabin in the forest. It is the residence of [[kira|Kira]] (huntress), [[jack|Jack]], and their adult son, [[kenny|Kenny]]. Kira and her family live in the forest as Kira spends her days watching [[cavern|The Mine]]. Although retired, she still makes sure that there are no loose monsters.

cavern.x: The Cavern is located all the way at the back of [[starlet-town|Starlet Town]], at the northwestern corner of the [[map|map]]. Initially inaccessible, the cavern becomes available on Day 5 of the game.

Inside the cavern, the player can [[mining|mine]] for [[ore-group|ore]]s, precious [[gem|gems]], and other items for [[crafting|crafting]]. However, there are [[monster|monsters]] roaming around, and sometimes the player will need to defeat them first before going to deeper into the mine.

All of the mines in the cavern consist of 40 levels with an elevator every five floors, except for the 35th, and a reward chest every tenth. Once the player reaches the bottom, they unlock the next available mine in the order: Earth, Water, Wind, and Fire.

ranch.x: The Ranch is located near the foot of the forest and it is run by [[jack|Jack]] and [[kenny|Kenny]]. The Ranch is often unattended at night.
The player can purchase a variety of livestock here once they have the necessary farm buildings to keep them, as well as feed and tools for their care.
Jack starts selling different animals as you upgrade your [[town-rank|town's rank]].
These items are also available [[sturdy-computer|online]] and not restricted by the shop operating hours.

pufferfish-drilling-corp.x: Pufferfish Drilling Corporation is an oil rig company who recently opened its regional office in [[starlet-town|Starlet Town]]. The Coral Island region of Pufferfish is represented by [[karen|Karen]].

They are a disgraced company whose goal is to drill oil on and around Coral Island. Set to open this [[spring|Spring]], they plan to lobby their way into the community and collect properties to secure voting rights.

emmas-cottage.x: Emma’s Cottage is the cottage where [[emma|Emma]] lives with her partner, [[dippa|Dippa]].

emmas-taco-truck.x: Emma’s Taco Truck is a food establishment located near [[starlet-elementary-school|Starlet Elementary School]]. It is owned and run by [[emma|Emma]]. Emma uses local ingredients that she finds around the forest and purchases goods from local farmers.
The player can now buy items from the taco truck as of the 1.1 update.
The shop is open from 12:00 to 17:00.
The shop is closed on Wednesdays.

mayors-house.x: Mayor’s house is the place where Mayor [[connor|Connor]] lives.

sanchez-brothers-blacksmith.x: Sanchez’ Brothers Blacksmith, owned by [[rafael|Rafael]] and [[pablo|Pablo]], will help the player with processing ores, upgrading tools, and their combat needs. The player can also purchase various weapons and armor here.
The store is stocked with [[ore-group|ore]] and [[coal|coal]]. These items are also available [[sturdy-computer|online]] and not restricted by the shop operating hours.

For 20g per item, the Blacksmith will process geodes and treasure coffers into [[gem|gems]] and [[artifact|artifacts]]. The items the blacksmith can process are: [[earth-geode|Earth geode]] · [[fire-geode|Fire geode]] · [[mystery-geode|Mystery geode]] · [[water-geode|Water geode]] · [[wind-geode|Wind geode]] · [[coffer|Coffer]] · [[ornate-coffer|Ornate coffer]] · [[shimmering-coffer|Shimmering coffer]] · [[mysterious-coffer|Mysterious coffer]] · [[marble-coffer|Marble coffer]] · [[pirate-coffer|Pirate coffer]]
The items the player will get are determined in the moment the geode or coffer is processed, so it is possible to reload the day to get different drops.

Each tool upgrade costs money, materials, and 1 to 4 full game-day(s) depending on which upgrade you are processing. When the player visits the Blacksmith and selects a tool to upgrade, that tool will be removed from your inventory until you return to pick it up. However, the shop is closed on Sundays' so if you choose to upgrade a tool on a Saturday, you will have to wait until Monday, at minimum to retrieve the tool.

starlet-elementary-school.x: Starlet Elementary School is the school where [[randy|Randy]] and the kids gather around for their daily discussion. The school opens from Monday to Friday, from 9 AM to 4 PM.

carpenter.x: The Carpenter is the home of [[joko|Joko]], [[dinda|Dinda]], [[archie|Archie]], and [[surya|Surya]], where Joko and Dinda run their construction business. The player has the opportunity to buy building and crafting materials, as well as construct and upgrade farm buildings. The player also has the option to alter the exterior appearance of their house and farm buildings.
These items are also available [[sturdy-computer|online]] and not restricted by the shop operating hours.

There are 3 other modes beside shop, carpenter to build new buildings, house upgrade or edit building. The edit option also allows the player to upgrade, move or destroy current buildings on the farm. Moving costs 300 or and requires 1 day to complete. Destroying costs 1,000 or and requires 1 day to complete. Note that currently the 3 modes are combined into this section for scripting purpose.

hillside-brewery-and-vineyard.x: Hillside Brewery and Vineyard is located on the far east of the [[farm|farm]] and produces solely sake and wine. It is also where [[luke|Luke]], [[bree|Bree]], and [[walter|Walter]] live; their manor is behind the vineyard. Bree oversees the Brewery's quality control. They do not sell their products directly to consumers, but they provide for local establishments and export most of their alcoholic beverages to neighboring countries.

i: Luke also runs [[socket-and-pan|Socket Electronics]], a store unaffiliated with the Brewery.

museum.x: The Museum is located to the left of the [[community-center|Community Center]] and is also the place where [[scott|Scott]] works. The player can donate [[artifact|artifact]]s, [[gem|gem]]s, [[sea-critter|critter]]s, [[insect|insect]]s, [[fish|fish]] and more here. Donations are put on display here. The Museum opens on the third day of Spring of the first year, entering for the first time will trigger « Empty No More ».
Each donation will contribute 3 points Museum. On top of that, each completion of the whole set of artifacts, fossils, gems, insects, fish, and ocean critter will contribute 40 points Museum.

A better and bigger version of the museum is available after completing the « Pickstarter Launch » which also unlock museum [[waypoint|waypoint]], [[soft-bristle-brush|Soft Bristle Brush]], earn 50 points Museum and 70 points Heart with all [[townies|townies]].
As the player donates items to the museum, they can unlock various rewards for reaching certain amounts of donations.
Saves created prior to v0.2 when the rewards were added should receive all eligible rewards on their next donation.

laboratory.x: The Laboratory is located in [[starlet-town|Starlet Town]] and is currently run by the town's only marine biologist, [[ling|Ling]]. It is also the place where [[surya|Surya]] conducts his research. The town’s laboratory is open Sunday-Friday and is closed on Saturdays.
The player can come to Ling with bottled kelp essences to upgrade their seeds or fodder. The player can also purchase various items from the cash register or process any fossil nodes they have.
The player can purchase the ingredients for making kelp essences right in the lab. These items are also available [[sturdy-computer|online]] and not restricted by the shop operating hours.

The Laboratory allows the player to purchase seed or fodder upgrades for gold and kelp essences. The research takes time, and only one upgrade can be bought at a time. After the upgrade is completed, player is not required to collect it manually from the lab, furthermore, the result will automatically be applied to all existing and future seed/seedling/sapling and hay (whether they are in inventory, chest or already planted or future purchase from shops).

farmhouse.x: The Farmhouse is where the [[player|player]] starts the game. It has several facilities to cover the basic necessities of the player.

The player uses this to end the day and continue to the next day. It also automatically saves the game. The bed can be moved anywhere within the house, it can also be replaced with a different style of bed, but it can never be completely removed as this is core furniture in the game; you must have a bed in order to exit Decor Mode.
The TV gives the player several helpful information about the day such as:

i: Weather Forecast: The weather channel informs the player of the forecast for the next day. It is always 100% accurate.

Today's Luck: The luck channel informs the player of their current luck value. This is especially helpful when the player needs to go to certain areas that increase the chances of getting a better item due to luck.

farmhouse.x: Every piece of furniture inside the farmhouse can be changed and customized. To do that, the player must press the button to enter "Decor Mode." Once in Decor Mode, the player can do the following:

i: Picks Up Furniture: pick existing furniture to move
Move Furniture: move the furniture within the house
Rotate Furniture: rotate the direction of the furniture. There are only four directions: north, east, west, and south.
Place Furniture: place the furniture in the desired location.

farmhouse.x: Note, you must have a bed, you cannot exit Decor Mode unless you have placed a bed.
Several styles are available for the house. The default is style 1. The player is able to change their Farmhouse style at the [[carpenter|Carpenter]] for x1000.
Extra features can be unlocked by upgrading the house. The house can still be used as normal during the upgrade.

farm.x: The farm is where [[player|player]]s live and can grow [[crop|crop]]s and [[fruit-tree|fruit tree]]s, tend [[farm-animal|farm animal]]s, and keep [[pet|pet]]s. The player's [[farmhouse|house]] and any farm buildings are located on the farm. The farm is west of [[starlet-town|Starlet Town]], both located on Coral Island.
At the beginning of Coral Island, the farm is overgrown by nature, but with the help of [[tool|tool]]s, it can be turned into valuable farmland.
The farm can be run by a single player in singleplayer mode or by multiple players in the online multiplayer or split-screen co-op modes.

The farmhouse is the player's residence and the area where they start every game day. The farmhouse has the player's bed and their TV are. The player can customize how their farmhouse looks and place [[furniture|furniture]] inside.

At the start of the game, the player's farm has their farmhouse, the [[shipping-bin|shipping bin]], the foundation for the [[greenhouse|greenhouse]], and several immovable ponds for [[fishing|fishing]].

The player can build a variety of farm buildings at the [[carpenter|Carpenter]]'s and place them at the farm to grow [[farm-animal|farm animals]]. The greenhouse will be restored automatically the night after the player completes all [[lake-temple|offering]]s at the [[lake-temple|first temple altar]].

Debris are items like twigs, stone, trash, and weeds that the player can clear with their [[tool|tools]]. At the beginning of the game the farm is overgrown with debris, and the player must clear it to free space for their crops, machines, and buildings. Debris will also spawn on unoccupied land over time.
Wild [[trees|trees]] also grow on the farm and can be cleared with an [[axe|axe]].

band-of-smiles.x: The Band of Smiles is an adventurers' guild active in the Coral Island area. [[kira|Kira]] runs the island's local branch and makes the final decisions on its membership while [[jio-dan|Jio Dan]] runs the guild store. The hideout also contains a job board to take on guild-specific [[quest|Errands]].

[[mark|Mark]] and visiting adventurers, [[axel|Axel]] and [[senja|Senja]], are also members and can be found frequenting the guild's hideout next door to Kira's home at the [[huntress-cabin|Huntress Cabin]].

The Band of Smiles Hideout is locked at the beginning of the game and can only be accessed once the player has completed the trial Kira sets out for them. After the player has reached level 10 of the [[cavern|Earth mine]], Kira sends the following letter:

Slaying the 30 monsters required for the [[quest|quest]] Entrance Exam directs the player to the Band of Smiles Hideout where Kira and the present guild members finalize the player's initiation into the guild. Once a member, the player has full access to the guild's services during its open hours.

The Band of Smiles has its own job board separate from the one found in [[starlet-town|Starlet Town]]. Errands posted to this board typically involve fighting monsters or obtaining resources from the [[cavern|cavern]]. Further details on the types of errands requested by the Band of Smiles can be found on the [[quest|Errands]] page.

The guild store sells a variety of items and equipment useful for adventuring in the cavern. New stock is added as the player progresses through the mines and ocean levels in their [[combat|Combat]] skill and completes errands for the guild.

merfolk-kingdom.x: The Merfolk Kingdom is where the [[merfolk|merfolk]] off the coast of Coral Island live. The kingdom is ruled by [[krakatoa|King Krakatoa]] and [[nanda-devi|Queen Nanda Devi]] from [[naga-palace|Naga Palace]]. There are many merfolk villages around the world, and some characters allude to being from other merfolk places.

The kingdom is unlocked once all the [[ocean|Dua Pulu]] solar orbs are activated and the player has completed the quest « Merfolk Kingdom ». Once unlocked, the player can reach the Merfolk Kingdom by [[diving|diving]] or [[warp-sesajen|warping]].

The Coral Tree, located on the right side of the kingdom, is an underwater sacred tree. Pufferfish's oil spill infected the tree and it can be healed by completing the quest « The Coral Tree ». The player must visit the Coral Tree in order to complete the quest « Roots Above ».

starlet-town.x: Starlet Town is one of the primary locations of Coral Island, set on the titular Coral Island. Many townsfolk live in and around town, and the available amenities fill all the basic needs. The [[player|player]]'s [[farm|farm]] is a short walk away.
The town center area has a variety of forageables and catchable insects.

2-main-ave.x: 2 Main Avenue is the house where [[jim|Jim]] lives with his two children: [[lily|Lily]] and [[theo|Theo]].

charles-house.x: 1 Main Ave (also known as Charles House) is the home shared by [[charles|Charles]] and [[scott|Scott]]. It is located near [[zarahs-boat|Zarah's Boat]], behind the [[clinic|clinic]].

garden-lane.x: Garden Lane is the green area between the [[farm|farm]] to the west and [[starlet-town|Starlet Town]] to the east. [[millie|Millie]] and [[yuri|Yuri]]'s [[millie-and-yuri-house|home]] is located in Garden Lane.

2-parkview.x: House where [[frank|Frank]] and [[erika|Erika]] live with their two cats [[peanut|Peanut]] and [[butter-character|Butter]].

lookout.x: The Lookout point is located west of the Beach and south of the [[farm|Farm]], at the southernmost point of Coral Island. It is home to the [[lighthouse|Lighthouse]].

woodlands.x: The Woodlands of Coral Island are situated west of the [[lake|Lake]] and north of [[starlet-town|Starlet Town]]. This area includes the [[starlet-elementary-school|school]], [[emmas-taco-truck|Emma's Taco Truck]], and the houses of multiple islanders who prefer the quiet of nature and nearby river over living in the town. Head further west to see the [[hillside|Hillside]] on the way to the untamed trees of the [[forest|Forest]].

hot-spring.x: The Hot Spring is an area of natural springs and bamboo forest in the northernmost section of the [[map|map]], positioned north of the [[hillside-brewery-and-vineyard|Vineyard]] and [[observatory|Observatory]], and between the [[forest|Forest]] and [[woodlands|Woodlands]] to its west and east respectively. At the beginning of the game, most of the hot spring area is blocked by vines, but small parts of the region outside of the vines still count as part of it for finding [[insect|insect]]s and [[foraging|foraging]]. The [[bath-house|Bath House]] can be found here, as well as the occasional panda.

ocean.x: The ocean is the large body of water in which Coral Island is situated. It is home to a wide variety of corals, [[fish|fish]], and other [[sea-critter|sea life]], as well as the rumored location of a [[merfolk-kingdom|merfolk kingdom]], that the player may come across while [[fishing|fishing]] or [[diving|diving]].
Depth

The ocean is divided into five zones based on their depth and walled off from each other by black growths caused by the oil spill. As the player restores the area by collecting solar orbs and activating the beacons, access to greater depths is unlocked.
There are a total of 85 beacons across the ocean, divided in 4 big unlockeable areas.
Se Pulu (10m)
When diving for the first time, the player starts out in the shallowest part of the 10-20m zone. [[bronze-kelp|Bronze kelp]] can be gathered here once some of the [[trash|trash]] is cleared.
This area has a total of 20 beacons for the player to activate before moving further.
The 10-20m zone is further divided into four areas (listed counter-clockwise from upper left):
Dua Pulu (20m)
After activating 20 beacons in the 10-20m zone, the player is able to move on the 20-30m zone. [[silver-kelp|Silver kelp]] can be gathered here once some of the [[trash|trash]] is cleared.
This area has a total of 20 beacons to be activated by the player before moving further to finding the [[merfolk-kingdom|Merfolk Kingdom]]
The 20-30m zone is further divided into four areas (listed counter-clockwise from left):
Merfolk Kingdom (30m)
After activating beacons in the 20-30m zone, the player is able to move on the 30-40m zone. This zone is entirely occupied by the Merfolk Kingdom.
Empat Pulu (40m)
After passing through the Merfolk Kingdom, the player is able to move on the 40-50m zone. [[gold-kelp|Gold kelp]] can be gathered here once some of the [[trash|trash]] is cleared.
In this area, the player must activate 22 beacons before moving on.
The 40-50m zone is further divided into six areas (listed counter-clockwise from bottom):
Lima Pulu (50m)
After activating beacons in the 40-50m zone, the player is able to move on the 50-60m zone. [[osmium-kelp|Osmium kelp]] can be gathered here once some of the [[trash|trash]] is cleared.
In this area, there are final 23 beacons for the player to activate.

rajas-coffee-corner.x: Raja's Coffee Corner is a small outdoor coffee shop run by [[raj|Raj]] in front of the [[fishensips|Fishensips]] in town docks. The shop offers [[cooking|cooked]] desserts and beverages for sale.
Raj's shop is closed on [[weather|rainy or stormy days]].

Some items sold in the coffee shop are seasonal, others are available all year round. These items are also available [[sturdy-computer|online]], not restricted by the shop operating hours and purchase limit.

bath-house.x: Bath House is a hot spring run by [[takeba|Takeba]]. It is temporarily unavailable at the start of the game.

The hot spring is restored the night after the player completes two [[lake-temple|offering]]s at [[lake-temple|lake temple]] and becomes free to use to refill the player's [[energy|energy]]. Note that the hot spring does not restore [[health|health]]. The speed at which energy refills increases as more offerings are completed, and the appearance of the hot springs will also improve. The amount of energy gained per "tick" (approximately one second real time) changes based on game speed setting; energy gain at 100% is twice that at 50%, so the same amount of in-game time gives the same amount of energy. observatory.x: Observatory is one of the buildings in [[starlet-town|Startlet Town]]. It is located north of the [[hillside-brewery-and-vineyard|Hillside Brewery and Vineyard]]. [[chaem|Chaem]] and [[wakuu|Wakuu]] live here. Chaem's bedroom is located on the left side of the building. Wakuu's bedroom is located on the right side of the building. On the weekends Wakkuu will stay with his dad, [[wataru|Wataru]]. The Observatory is open everyday from 9 am to 9 pm.

white-flamingo.x: White Flamingo is the clothing store in [[starlet-town|Starlet Town]] owned by [[antonio|Antonio]]. It begins as a tent next to Ling's Mansion and opens as a full-sized store when the player reaches [[town-rank|town rank]] E.
More clothing options become available to purchase as the player increases the town rank.
The unnamed clothing tent has reduced hours and is closed Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.
These items are also available [[sturdy-computer|online]] and not restricted by the shop operating hours, buying online however, may not trigger certain [[badges|badges]].
